title: Locker Webapp
oneLineDescription: A UI for self-service parcel pickup and drop-off
description: An on-device UI for parcel lockers, handling automated pickup and drop-off across first- and last-mile delivery for one of the worlds largest logistics companies. The webapp is designed to run on a variety of hardware platforms, including specific sensor connections

team.label: Scrum Team: 1 designer, 3 software engineers, 1 PO, 1 Infrastructure engineer

tech: Custom harness skills to model xState from Figma flows
Safe transactions with partial offline support with service workers and background sync
Planned updates while continuous operation without interrupting customers
Otel-conform tracing and metrics with Prometheus and visible in Grafana
